# PWA Icons

Place your app icons here before deploying:

- `icon-192.png` — 192 × 192 px  (required)
- `icon-512.png` — 512 × 512 px  (required)
- `apple-touch-icon.png` — 180 × 180 px (recommended for iOS Safari)

All icons should use a solid background (no transparency) for best
cross-platform compatibility. The `maskable` purpose means Android
adaptive icons will crop to a circle — keep the Shoreline logo
centered within the inner 80% safe zone.
